# Pixel Tic-Tac-Toe

A two-player pixel-style tic-tac-toe game built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No external dependencies, no network requests — fully offline.

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. That's it.

## Features

- Two players: X goes first, then O
- Live turn indicator
- Win detection with winning line highlight
- Draw detection
- Restart button to reset the game
- Keyboard accessible: Tab to navigate, Enter/Space to place a mark
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Pixel-inspired visual style with hover, focus, and pressed states

## Files

- `index.html` — page structure
- `styles.css` — pixel-themed styling
- `script.js` — game logic

## Accessibility

- All controls are native `<button>` elements with labels
- Status updates use `aria-live="polite"`
- Visible focus outlines on all interactive elements
